nl_queries: 按 type 分组，计算 price 的 P50 和 P95 分位数。
给出各组的中位数和高分位数。

Compute approximate P50 and P95 of price per type.
train_records.MQL: db.properties.aggregate([ { $group: { _id: "$type", p50: { $percentile: { input: "$price", p: [0.5], method: "approximate" } }, p95: { $percentile: { input: "$price", p: [0.95], method: "approximate" } } } }, { $project: { _id: 0, type: "$_id", p50: 1, p95: 1 } }])

nl_queries: 按 year 计算 price 的滑动基线，只保留显著高于基线的异常记录。
找出超过滚动平均基线的异常点。

用滑动基线筛出高于预期的记录。
Detect anomalies above the rolling baseline of price.
train_records.MQL: db.properties.aggregate([ { $setWindowFields: { sortBy: { "year": 1 }, output: { moving_avg: { $avg: "$price", window: { documents: [-2, 0] } } } } }, { $match: { $expr: { $gt: ["$price", { $multiply: ["$moving_avg", 1.25] }] } } }, { $project: { _id: 0, city: 1, price: "$price", moving_avg: 1 } }])
